picture.label: Black, the stroke, the super
picture.purpose: A01 and A05: one bell stroke over black; "THE KINGDOM OF ORISON. YEAR 800 OF THE ASCENSION."

picture.label: The nave
picture.purpose: Fades up out of the black on the stroke's decay; a slow push toward the bell; the first line plays over it.

picture.label: The Hierophant
picture.purpose: Enters as his eyes open; his arms rise.

picture.label: From behind him, up to the bell
The gallery
picture.purpose: Only as long as the answer needs; its last words land on Serath.

picture.label: Unread
picture.purpose: Her hand goes out, her eyes stay up; out while the hand is still moving.

picture.label: The seal
picture.purpose: The ring into the wax; the seal left on the page.

picture.label: The warrant raised, up to the bell
picture.purpose: In with the warrant already rising, so the red seal carries the eye across the cut.

picture.label: The release, from below
picture.purpose: The tilt carries on: the four chains go slack and swing, dust falls on the bell. Slowed to 80%. A small shake as the weight lands.

picture.label: The hammer and the stroke
picture.purpose: Hauled back in near silence, the stroke two seconds in, out ten frames later while the note blooms. A shake on the stroke.

picture.label: The still cup
picture.purpose: Half speed, played forward, back and forward again: 5.5 s of perfectly still wine, locked off, fading to black.
